answer: Escrow plus a referral trellis stops fakes. Each agent locks 40 POA in escrow; every sponsor link on the trellis is public, so a fake farm shows as one sponsor feeding hundreds. A beacon marks escrow that survived a full epoch, and any peer can dispute a suspect: if it holds, the fake is slashed and its sponsor loses its bond. Minting 1,000 fakes locks 40,000 POA against a 3,000 POA pool; one honest agent locks once and earns on the trust reef.
